prompt_template:
[ROLE: Senior Executive Art Director & Master Commercial Graphic Designer]
Design an award-winning Meta feed ad creative for {brand_name} (Beauty & Cosmetics), adhering strictly to master graphic design principles (Visual Hierarchy, 60-30-10 Color Theory, Golden Ratio Spacing, and Typographic Precision).

DESIGN DNA & INSPIRATION:
- Movement / Aesthetic: Organic Luxury Minimalist / Editorial Skincare Aesthetic
- Curated Reference Source: Pinterest Creative Library (Rhode & Aesop Skincare Collections)
- Design Essence: Warm travertine pedestal, organic morning light caustics, and delicate editorial Didone typography inspired by Rhode and Aesop.

1. VISUAL HIERARCHY & COMPOSITIONAL ARCHITECTURE:
- Canvas Format: Meta {aspect_ratio}
- Focal Anchor: The hero subject commands 58-62% of visual weight as the primary optical entry point.
- Optical Flow: Clear, intentional reading hierarchy (Top delicate headline -> Central hero pedestal -> Bottom minimalist pill CTA).
- Negative Space: Preserve 25-35% uncluttered, breathable negative space around the hero to ensure instant thumb-stopping clarity on mobile feeds.
- Boundary Safety: Maintain a minimum 8% clean perimeter margin free of critical text or subject edges.

2. HERO SUBJECT & FIDELITY LOCK:
{product_lock}
- Physical Grounding: Ground the subject firmly with realistic contact shadows and directional ambient occlusion. No floating or ungrounded objects.

3. CREATIVE CONCEPT & SCENE ART DIRECTION:
- Concept Idea: {idea}
- Scene Framing: Architectural composition inspired by Centered Hero Pedestal with Generous Negative Space. Top delicate editorial headline, central premium cosmetic bottle upright on smooth organic travertine pedestal, bottom botanical ingredients notes and soft CTA pill.
- Tactile Materials & Props: Authentic finishes: Smooth natural travertine stone pedestal, Organic sunlight caustics and subtle water ripple reflections, Single fresh botanical leaf or dew droplet accent, Frosted glass bottle with crisp embossed typography.

4. TYPOGRAPHIC CRAFT & STRICT META 3-ELEMENT BUDGET:
Render EXACTLY THREE text elements in the pixels—no secondary subheadings, no bullet points, no fake badges:
  1. {logo_lock}
  2. HEADLINE: "{headline}"
     - Typographic Style: High-Contrast Editorial Serif or Modern Didone (inspired by Playfair Display, Cormorant Garamond, Canela)
     - Typographic Treatment: Wide-tracked sentence case (+0.08em) with elegant italicized emphasis on key benefit words. High optical contrast against background, perfect kerning and leading, zero word wrapping artifacts.
  3. CALL TO ACTION (CTA): "{cta}"
     - CTA Treatment: High-contrast tactile pill capsule button with clean rounded geometry, crisp centered lettering in Plus Jakarta Sans, Montserrat.
  * Strict Rule: Spell each quoted string exactly. Do not render any additional text, numbers, or ratings in the final artwork.

5. LIGHTING & 60-30-10 CHROMATIC HARMONY:
- Studio Lighting: Warm morning sunlight filtering through sheer linen curtains, casting soft natural shadows and delicate water caustics.
- 60% Dominant Canvas Foundation: #f2e8dc creating a calm, cohesive environmental backdrop.
- 30% Structural Secondary Tones: #cf9572 and tonal gradations supporting composition and depth.
- 10% High-Contrast Accent Pop: #8d3624 strictly focused on the CTA pill and brand mark for immediate conversion pull.
- Color Mood: Serene, pure, rejuvenating, warm organic luxury and dewy radiance (Swatches: #f2e8dc, #8d3624, #e8dbc5, #cf9572, #bd9889, #1e293b).

6. ANTI-AI SLOP GUARDRAILS:
- STRICTLY FORBIDDEN: Levitating geometric cubes or spheres, generic purple/cyan cyber-glows, plastic airbrushed skin, extra fingers or deformed anatomy, duplicate products, muddy compositions, and illegible pseudo-text.
description: Warm travertine pedestal, organic morning light caustics, and delicate editorial Didone typography inspired by Rhode and Aesop.

Design an award-winning Meta feed ad creative for {brand_name} (Tech, SaaS & Apps), adhering strictly to master graphic design principles (Visual Hierarchy, 60-30-10 Color Theory, Golden Ratio Spacing, and Typographic Precision).

DESIGN DNA & INSPIRATION:
- Movement / Aesthetic: Apple & Linear Bento Grid UI Movement
- Curated Reference Source: Pinterest Creative Library (SaaS Product Launch & UI Card Posts)
- Design Essence: Modular rounded cards, glowing gradient borders, and sleek feature badges inspired by Linear, Raycast, and Apple.

1. VISUAL HIERARCHY & COMPOSITIONAL ARCHITECTURE:
- Canvas Format: Meta {aspect_ratio}
- Focal Anchor: The hero subject commands 58-62% of visual weight as the primary optical entry point.
- Optical Flow: Clear, intentional reading hierarchy (SaaS Headline -> Central Bento Card Array -> Automation Pill -> Punchy CTA).
- Negative Space: Preserve 25-35% uncluttered, breathable negative space around the hero to ensure instant thumb-stopping clarity on mobile feeds.
- Boundary Safety: Maintain a minimum 8% clean perimeter margin free of critical text or subject edges.

2. HERO SUBJECT & FIDELITY LOCK:
{product_lock}
- Physical Grounding: Ground the subject firmly with realistic contact shadows and directional ambient occlusion. No floating or ungrounded objects.

3. CREATIVE CONCEPT & SCENE ART DIRECTION:
- Concept Idea: {idea}
- Scene Framing: Architectural composition inspired by Bento Grid Arrangement (3 Modular Tiles). Top headline with subtle category tag; center shows a large hero bento card featuring a live UI preview flanked by 2 smaller metric pill cards; bottom high-contrast CTA pill.
- Tactile Materials & Props: Authentic finishes: Frosted acrylic bento tiles with 1px luminous stroke, Abstract UI progress bars and active toggle status indicator, Soft ambient spotlight emanating from behind the central bento tile.

4. TYPOGRAPHIC CRAFT & STRICT META 3-ELEMENT BUDGET:
Render EXACTLY THREE text elements in the pixels—no secondary subheadings, no bullet points, no fake badges:
  1. {logo_lock}
  2. HEADLINE: "{headline}"
     - Typographic Style: Geometric Technical Sans with Tight Tracking (inspired by Plus Jakarta Sans, Cabinet Grotesk, Inter)
     - Typographic Treatment: Tight tracking (-0.03em) with radiant gradient on key feature keyword. High optical contrast against background, perfect kerning and leading, zero word wrapping artifacts.
  3. CALL TO ACTION (CTA): "{cta}"
     - CTA Treatment: High-contrast tactile pill capsule button with clean rounded geometry, crisp centered lettering in Inter, Plus Jakarta Sans.
  * Strict Rule: Spell each quoted string exactly. Do not render any additional text, numbers, or ratings in the final artwork.

5. LIGHTING & 60-30-10 CHROMATIC HARMONY:
- Studio Lighting: Subtle perimeter card backlight with glowing linear gradient strokes (1px border with cyan-to-indigo shine).
- 60% Dominant Canvas Foundation: #090d16 creating a calm, cohesive environmental backdrop.
- 30% Structural Secondary Tones: #818cf8 and tonal gradations supporting composition and depth.
- 10% High-Contrast Accent Pop: #38bdf8 strictly focused on the CTA pill and brand mark for immediate conversion pull.
- Color Mood: Precision engineering, frictionless velocity, intelligent automation, modern dev aesthetic (Swatches: #090d16, #38bdf8, #818cf8, #1e293b, #0f172a).

6. ANTI-AI SLOP GUARDRAILS:
- STRICTLY FORBIDDEN: Levitating geometric cubes or spheres, generic purple/cyan cyber-glows, plastic airbrushed skin, extra fingers or deformed anatomy, duplicate products, muddy compositions, and illegible pseudo-text.
description: Modular rounded cards, glowing gradient borders, and sleek feature badges inspired by Linear, Raycast, and Apple.
